## Checklist

- [ ] PR title is a conventional commit with a scope (e.g. `fix(emitter): ...`)
- [ ] Tests added or updated for the change
- [ ] `composer validate` and the quality gates pass (`composer qa`)
- [ ] Generated-output determinism is unaffected, or snapshots are updated and the diff is explained
- [ ] No em dashes anywhere (code, comments, docs)
